text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the Senior Class year. To pray 
for Manhattan Cafe's success, we came for 
Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... where is Tachyon-san...? She's 
usually tagging along lately, even when I 
don't ask.
choice_data_list: They said they're too busy to come.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hatsumode, is it? Sorry, but my research 
is just getting busy right now, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Now that Cafe's condition has improved, 
the strain on her hooves and cannon bones 
has become immense! It's almost 
laughable."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll see what I can do. As I'm sure 
you know, not a word of this to anyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If the other teams ask about me, just 
tell them, 'She caught a cold and is 
sleeping at the hotel.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her own way, Agnes Tachyon was 
desperately thinking about Manhattan 
Cafe's well-being.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So it's just the two of us today... isn't 
it... For some reason, my "friend" isn't 
here either...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Arima Kinen, Manhattan Cafe 
started acting strange, but... she isn't 
always like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's usually so quiet and gentle, but...

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Gather 'round, everyone, and make your 
New Year's prayers! No matter the wish, 
I'm sure the gods will grant it for you!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —You're lying, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Wishes don't come true. In a place like 
this—there is no serene god.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... it happens like this from time 
to time. I wonder if there's some kind of 
trigger for it?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this way... ...Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —To the city that grants any wish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The place I was brought to was a bizarre 
town that hardly felt like New Year's at 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"This is... the one and only town that 
will truly make wishes come true..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To catch up to my "friend"... What is it 
that you wish for, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From the thoughts that have surfaced... 
choose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mysterious words materialized beneath our 
feet. Trembling, the choice we made 
was..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Soothing... Yes, indeed... The stars... 
are watching over us..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I can bask in the light of those 
unyielding stars...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I've gotten a bit of 
my energy back...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think I can do my best in training. 
Without looking down... forward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Was that town merely an illusion...? In 
any case, the life has returned to 
Manhattan Cafe's face."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Scales all over my body... As if 
covering... my hair... my retinas... my 
very soul...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If only I could bulk up my very 
existence... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The sea at night. I had a dream of 
falling through the water. Endlessly... 
endlessly..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how strange. According to the 
measurements, Cafe's strength and stamina 
have slightly increased.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You say you went for Hatsumode, but were 
you actually training instead?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's not the case. But still, it seems 
that prayer did have some sort of effect.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The wisdom of those who have passed... The 
memories of our forebears...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If only I could catch a glimpse... even a 
faint one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Memories I could not possibly possess came 
flowing into me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A landscape I don't even know truly 
existed. And the ancient wisdom connected 
to it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm starting to feel like there 
are all kinds of ways to run. Even more...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The inspiration I had... I want to try it 
out from now on. In an actual race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A torrent of history. Perhaps she saw 
something that only Manhattan Cafe could 
see."
